name: Velvet Flat White
description: Double ristretto poured over micro-textured steamed milk, crafting a rich, dense velvety consistency with a sweet caramel finish.

name: Smoked Bourbon Espresso
description: Aged single-origin Bourbon beans roasted in vintage cast iron, extracted at 9 bars for intense body with subtle smoky oak notes.

name: Tahitian Vanilla Cappuccino
description: Infused with organic Tahitian vanilla pods, layered with espresso and feather-light dry velvet foam dusted with raw cacao.

name: Aztec Spiced Dark Mocha
description: Single-estate chocolate melted into double espresso with hints of Ceylon cinnamon and Mexican smoked ancho chili.

name: 24-Hour Nitro Velvet Brew
description: Steeped for 24 hours at 4°C, infused with food-grade pure nitrogen for a cascading waterfall of micro-bubbles and natural creamy sweetness.

name: Cascara Slow-Drip Tonic
description: Brewed from dried organic coffee cherry husks (cascara), paired with artisanal Indian tonic and expressed Meyer lemon peel.

name: Sea Salt Caramel Cold Cloud
description: Slow-steeped cold brew crowned with hand-whipped salted caramel velvet cream and flakes of flaky Cornish sea salt.

name: Kyoto Tower Ice Drip Reserve
description: Extracted drop by drop over 12 hours through our vintage Japanese slow-drip glass towers. Ultra-clean, low acidity with cognac undertones.

name: Ethiopian Yirgacheffe G1 V60
description: Washed heirloom beans hand-poured through Hario V60 spiral dripper at 93°C. Tea-like delicacy with vibrant citrus luminescence.

name: Panama Geisha Chemex Reserve
description: Rare award-winning Geisha lot brewed through thick triple-bonded Chemex filters. An ethereal floral bouquet with crystalline clarity.

name: Sumatra Mandheling French Press
description: Wet-hulled Giling Basah processing steeped in insulated copper press. Viscous mouthfeel, earthy spices, and zero astringency.

name: Velvet Espresso Tiramisu Tart
description: Handmade cocoa sablé crust layered with espresso-soaked ladyfingers, velvety whipped mascarpone sabayon, and 24k edible gold leaf.

name: Pistachio Affogato Brioche
description: Warm artisanal butter brioche filled with Sicilian pistachio gelato, drowned tableside in a piping hot double shot of Velvet Roast espresso.

name: Dark Roast Basque Cheesecake
description: High-temperature scorched custard cheesecake infused with Madagascar vanilla bean and served with warm velvet espresso caramel drizzle.
